title: Edits, sparse autoencoders and jet sets for "Weight-space programming and mechanistic interpretability for model editing in particle physics"
domain: particle physics (jet tagging and jet mass regression)

headline_result.text: A companion data record with the weight edits of OmniLearned-s/m/l from fine-tuning, SAE-guided edits and weight-space-programming agent runs, plus SAE checkpoints, jet sets and cached results; it reports no results itself.
headline_result.quote: `edits/`: weight edits of OmniLearned-s/m/l: `finetuning/`, `sae/` (SAE-guided edits) and `agents/<variant>/<size>/run<n>/` (every edit handed in by the weight-space-programming runs).

key_claims.claim: The record contains every edit handed in by the weight-space-programming agent runs, alongside fine-tuning and SAE-guided edits of the same models.
key_claims.quote: `agents/<variant>/<size>/run<n>/` (every edit handed in by the weight-space-programming runs).

key_claims.claim: Jet mass regression heads were trained on the frozen body of the original model and of each edit.
key_claims.quote: the jet mass regression heads of Sec. 4 (ridge and MLP, trained on the frozen body of the original model and of each edit)

key_claims.claim: Each edit is stored as a partial state dict of full replacement float32 tensors.
key_claims.quote: each edit `.npz` is a partial state dict of full replacement float32 tensors; keys missing from the file keep their original values (an empty file is the unchanged model).

limitations_stated.text: The licence is not yet confirmed and the pretrained OmniLearned weights are not included.

notes_for_review: Data-only companion record for a particle-physics WSP paper whose full text is not in this record; it shows that agent-made edits of OmniLearned jet taggers were compared with fine-tuning and SAE-guided edits, but gives no numbers, editor model or authors. Useful as evidence that edits and SAEs are released; the results must come from the companion paper.
